governance_context: Replay-aware extension of example-completion-queue. Replay fields are advisory governance metadata; the queue itself is the authority.

replay_fields_schema.replay_reuse_run: run ID to reuse (or auto-detect pattern)
replay_fields_schema.replay_reason: why replay is recommended at this step
replay_fields_schema.replay_blocked_reason: why replay is not eligible or is blocked
replay_fields_schema.replay_eligible: boolean — whether replay is currently executable
replay_fields_schema.replay_safety_condition: conditions that must hold for replay to be safe

replay_selection_heuristics.REVIEWED: replay from reviewer — skip infra+generation+validation, rerun reviewer+publisher
replay_selection_heuristics.GENERATION_FAILED: replay from generation — skip infra only, rerun LLM generation forward
replay_selection_heuristics.VALIDATION_FAILED: replay from validation — skip infra+generation, rerun dotnet build+run forward
replay_selection_heuristics.PUBLISHER_FAILED: replay from publisher — only if reviewer available=True and gate publishable
replay_selection_heuristics.PERMANENTLY_BLOCKED: no replay — structural API issue requires package upgrade or design change

governance_invariants: publisher replay blocked if reviewer available=False
catalog hash verified against denominator before any replay proceeds
stale-artifact-check.json always written before raising ReplayIntegrityError
